command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20interface%20brief'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n); if(`$o -match 'not found'){Write-Output 'NOTFOUND'} else {foreach(`$line in (`$o -split '\r?\n')){if(`$line -match '%|Interface\s+PHY|Interface\s+IP|Interface\s+Status'){Write-Output `$line}}}}"
